name: 句子长度方差
description: Analyzes sentence length distribution for AI detection.
useCase: Identifying AI text through uniform sentence structure
mechanism: Measures the coefficient of variation in row-level energy patterns as a proxy for sentence length diversity. AI tends to produce sentences of more uniform length.
source: Uchendu et al. (2020) - Authorship Attribution for Neural Text Generation, EMNLP
parameters: Window size: adaptive, Quantization: 8-64 levels, Metrics: entropy, CV, correlation
strengths:
- Effective for detecting AI-generated text
- Language-agnostic statistical approach
- Works with any text length
- Low computational overhead
limitations:
- Less effective on edited or paraphrased AI text
- Domain-specific content may trigger false positives
- Short texts provide less reliable signals
- Performance varies across writing styles

references.title: Uchendu et al. (2020) - Authorship Attribution for Neural Text Generation, EMNLP
